an8.51:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
an8.51:1.2: atha kho mahāpajāpatī gotamī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho mahāpajāpatī gotamī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.51:1.3: sādhu bhante, labheyya mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:1.5: mā te rucci mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāti.
an8.51:2.1: dutiyampi kho mahāpajāpatī gotamī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.51:2.2: sādhu bhante, labheyya mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:2.4: mā te rucci, mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāti.
an8.51:3.1: tatiyampi kho mahāpajāpatī gotamī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.51:3.2: sādhu bhante, labheyya mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:3.4: mā te rucci, mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāti.
an8.51:4.1: atha kho mahāpajāpatī gotamī na bhagavā anujānāti mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an8.51:5.1: atha kho bhagavā kapilavatthusmiṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena vesālī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
an8.51:5.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena vesālī tadavasari.
an8.51:5.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an8.51:5.4: atha kho mahāpajāpatī gotamī kese chedāpetvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā sambahulāhi sākiyānīhi saddhiṃ yena vesālī tena pakkāmi.
an8.51:5.5: anupubbena yena vesālī mahāvane kūṭāgārasālaṃ tenupasaṅkami.
an8.51:5.6: atha kho mahāpajāpatī gotamī sunehi pādehi rajokiṇṇena gattena dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhāsi,
an8.51:6.1: addasā kho āyasmā ānando mahāpajāpatiṃ gotamiṃ sunehi pādehi rajokiṇṇena gattena dukkhiṃ dummanaṃ assumukhiṃ rudamānaṃ bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitaṃ,
an8.51:6.3: kinnu tvaṃ gotami, sunehi pādehi rajokiṇṇena gattena dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitāti?
an8.51:6.4: tathā hi pana bhante ānanda, na bhagavā anujānāti mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:6.5: tena hi gotamī, idheva tāva hohi, yāvāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ yācāmi mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:7.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.51:7.2: ‘esā bhante, mahāpajāpatī gotamī sunehi pādehi rajokiṇṇena gattena dukkhī dummanā assumukhī rudamānā bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā,
an8.51:7.3: na bhagavā anujānāti mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti’.
an8.51:7.4: sādhu bhante, labheyya mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti’.
an8.51:7.6: mā te rucci mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāti.
an8.51:8.2: tatiyampi kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.51:8.3: ‘sādhu bhante, labheyya mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti’
an8.51:8.5: māte rucci mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhamma vinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:9.2: na bhagavā anujānāti mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ.
an8.51:9.3: yannūnāhaṃ aññenapi pariyāyena bhagavantaṃ yāceyyaṃ mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:9.4: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.51:9.5: bhabbo nu kho bhante, mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā sotāpattiphalaṃ vā sakadāgāmiphalaṃ vā anāgāmiphalaṃ vā arahattaphalaṃ vā sacchikātunti?
an8.51:9.6: bhabbo ānanda mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā sotāpattiphalampi sakadāgāmiphalampi anāgāmiphalampi arahattaphalampi sacchikātunti.
an8.51:9.7: sace bhante, bhabbo mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā sotāpattiphalampi …pe… arahattaphalampi sacchikātuṃ,
an8.51:9.8: bahukārā bhante, mahāpajāpatī gotamī bhagavato mātucchā āpādikā posikā,
an8.51:9.10: sādhu bhante, labheyya mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjanti.
an8.51:10.1: sace ānanda, mahāpajāpatī gotamī aṭṭhagarudhamme patigaṇhāti, sāvassā hotu upasampadā.
an8.51:11.1: “vassasatūpasampannāya bhikkhuniyā tadahupasampannassa bhikkhuno abhivādanapaccuṭṭhānaañjalikamma sāmīcikammaṃ kattabbaṃ.
an8.51:11.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā. mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:12.1: na bhikkhuniyā abhikkhuke āvāse vassaṃ upagantabbaṃ,
an8.51:12.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:13.3: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:14.1: vassaṃ vutthāya bhikkhuniyā ubhato saṅghe tīhi ṭhānehi pavāretabbā:
an8.51:14.3: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:15.1: garudhammaṃ ajjhāpannāya bhikkhuniyā ubhato saṅghe pakkhamānattaṃ caritabbaṃ.
an8.51:15.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:16.1: dve vassāni chasu dhammesu sikkhitasikkhāya sikkhamānāya ubhato saṅghe upasampadā pariyesitabbā.
an8.51:16.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:17.1: na kenaci pariyāyena bhikkhuniyā bhikkhu akkositabbo paribhāsitabbo.
an8.51:17.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:18.1: ajjatagge ānanda, ovaṭo bhikkhunīnaṃ bhikkhūsu vacanapatho, anovaṭo bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīsu vacanapatho.
an8.51:18.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.”
an8.51:19.1: sace ānanda, mahāpajāpatī gotamī ime aṭṭhagarudhamme patigaṇhāti, sāvassā hotu upasampadāti.
an8.51:20.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato santike ime aṭṭhagarudhamme uggahetvā yena mahāpajāpatī gotamī tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā mahāpajāpatiṃ gotamiṃ etadavoca:
an8.51:21.1: sace kho tvaṃ gotami, aṭṭhagarudhamme patigaṇheyyāsi, sāva te bhavissati upasampadā.
an8.51:22.1: vassasatūpasampannāya bhikkhuniyā tadahupasampannassa bhikkhuno abhivādanapaccuṭṭhānaañjalikamma sāmīcikammaṃ kattabbaṃ.
an8.51:22.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo …pe…
an8.51:23.1: ajjatagge ovaṭo bhikkhunīnaṃ bhikkhūsu vacanapatho, anovaṭo bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīsu vacanapatho.
an8.51:23.2: ayampi dhammo sakkatvā garukatvā mānetvā pūjetvā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyo.
an8.51:23.3: sace kho tvaṃ gotamī, ime aṭṭhagarudhamme patigaṇhayyāsi, sāva te bhavissati upasampadāti.
an8.51:24.1: seyyathāpi bhante ānanda, itthi vā puriso vā daharo yuvāmaṇḍanakajātiko sīsaṃ nahāto uppalamālaṃ vā vassikamālaṃ vā atimuttakamālaṃ vā labhitvā ubhohi hatthehi paṭiggahetvā uttamaṅge sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhāpeyya
an8.51:24.2: evameva kho ahaṃ bhante, ime aṭṭhagarudhamme patigaṇhissāmi yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyeti.
an8.51:25.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi, ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an8.51:25.2: paṭiggahitā bhante, mahāpajāpatiyā gotamiyā aṭṭha garudhammā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyāti.
an8.51:26.1: sace ānanda, nālabhissa mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ, ciraṭṭhitikaṃ ānanda, brahmacariyaṃ abhavissa, vassasahassameva saddhammo patiṭṭhaheyya,
an8.51:26.2: yato ca kho ānanda, mātugāmo tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito, nadāni ānanda, brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ bhavissati,
an8.51:27.1: seyyathāpi ānanda, yāni kānici kulāni bahukitthikāni appurisakāni, tāni suppadhaṃsiyāni honti corehi kumbhatthenakehi.
an8.51:27.2: evameva kho ānanda, yasmiṃ dhammavinaye labhati mātugāmo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ, na taṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti.
an8.51:28.1: seyyathāpi ānanda, sampanne sālikkhette setaṭṭhikā nāmarogajāti nipatati, evaṃ taṃ sālikkhettaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti.
an8.51:28.2: evameva kho ānanda, yasmiṃ dhammavinaye labhati mātugāmo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ na taṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti.
an8.51:29.1: seyyathāpi ānanda, sampanne ucchukkhette mañjeṭṭhikā nāma rogajāti nipatati, evaṃ taṃ ucchukkhettaṃ na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti,
an8.51:29.2: evameva kho ānanda, yasmiṃ dhammavinaye labhati mātugāmo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjaṃ na taṃ brahmacariyaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti.
an8.51:30.1: seyyathāpi ānanda, puriso mahato taḷākassa paṭigacceva āḷiṃ bandheyya yāvadeva udakassa anatikkamanāya,
an8.51:30.2: evameva kho ānanda mayā paṭigacceva bhikkhunīnaṃ aṭṭha garudhammā paññattā yāvajīvaṃ anatikkamanīyāti.
